div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/artemis-radiation-measure-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Accumulated effective dose over a mission phase or period
Instantaneous or average dose rate during a measurement window
Component identifying the dominant radiation source (GCR, SPE, trapped, secondary)
Component identifying the shielding condition during the exposure
Component identifying the tissue or organ for which the dose is reported

description.value: Observation and component codes used by the ArtemisRadiationExposure profile: dose measures and the contextual components (radiation source, shielding condition, tissue type). Radiation source values come from SpaceRadiationTypeCS.
